title: Exact restriction preserves a scalar-extension derived pair
statement: Let A,D,B be commutative rings and f:A to D a ring homomorphism. Use the derived categories of [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let s:Mod(D) to Mod(B) be additive and preserve finite limits and finite colimits. If (L,epsilon) is a universal left derived functor for scalar extension along f, then L followed by derived s is a universal left derived functor of scalar extension along f followed by s. Its counit is epsilon postcomposed with derived s, followed by the canonical localization factorization for exact s.

proof.text: Scalar extension preserves quasi-isomorphisms between K-flat complexes. Reuse the proved scalarExtension_quasiIso_of_kFlat helper in KFlatScalarExtensionDerivedIso, whose argument tensors a mapping cone and uses mixed tensor K-flat invariance.

Exact s carries their localized isomorphisms to isomorphisms. Naturality of its localization factorization proves that scalar extension followed by s derives along the K-flat localizer. The K-flat left derivability structure and the criterion isLeftDerivedFunctor_iff_isIso_app_of_kFlat show the original counit is invertible on K-flat objects. Whiskering it with derived s and composing localization isomorphisms preserves invertibility. Apply isLeftDerivedFunctor_of_isIso for that derivability structure.

theorem scalarExtensionDerivedRestriction
    {A D B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing D] [CommRing B]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleCat.{u} A)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleCat.{u} D)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleCat.{u} B)]
    (f : A →+* D) (s : ModuleCat.{u} D ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} B)
    [s.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits s] [PreservesFiniteColimits s]
    (L : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A) ⥤ DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} D))
    (ε : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ L ⟶
      (extendScalars.{u, u, u} f).mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh)
    (hL : L.IsLeftDerivedFunctor ε (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso _ (.up ℤ))) :
    (L ⋙ s.mapDerivedCategory).IsLeftDerivedFunctor
      ((Functor.associator _ _ _).inv ≫ Functor.whiskerRight ε s.mapDerivedCategory ≫
        (Functor.associator _ _ _).hom ≫
        Functor.whiskerLeft ((extendScalars f).mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ))
          s.mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.hom ≫ (Functor.associator _ _ _).inv)
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso _ (.up ℤ))
